snippet.title: QT mod - PSYCHED UP EDITION Showcase
snippet.description:
Too cute to die for!
I highly recommend trying this mod out for yourself before watching this video!

Well, here it is, the final QT update.
Never would've thought this mod was going to explode in popularity but boy was I wrong. Either way, this video is the showcase for the Psyched Up Edition, specifically played in Harder difficulty to make it more fun for me and to showcase the new difficulty for those who haven't / can't play it. In case you're wondering as well, the ending dialogue for Terminate changes when on Harder to use the original placeholder text!

Thank you for supporting QT! 
♥♥♥

Download the mod: https://gamebanana.com/mods/299714
Check out and support the original game: https://ninja-muffin24.itch.io/funkin

Timestamps:
0:00 - Intro
0:25 - Carefree (1st song)
3:26 - Careless (2nd song)
6:08 - Censory-Overload (3rd song) [Spoilers]
12:19 - Terminate (4th song / ending) [Spoilers]
13:02 - Termination (bonus song) [Spoilers]
18:33 - Cessation (2nd bonus song) [Spoilers]
22:34 - Tutorial on Harder difficulty (Sawblade hell)
(Eh, what are you talking about? There isn't a secret song called 'Interlope'? I went down after beating Cessation and there wasn't anything there!)
